name: motion-canvas
vibe: An abstract motion-graphics reel on a warm cream canvas. Bold geometric shapes — a ringed circle, a spun square, a triangle and a tilted block — drift and rotate on a soft dot grid that flows unbroken across every cut. Kinetic bold type snaps and sweeps, screenshots are masked into bold shape frames with a hard offset accent shadow, stat bars grow in alternating accents, feature chips rise and a logo-reveal CTA lands. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole reel — every shape, stroke, fill, frame shadow, bar, chip and accent, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for confident, punchy, contemporary brands, design studios, app launches and anything that should feel like a designer's motion reel.
